_provenance.authority: Direção-Geral do Território — CAOP 2025 (freguesia and concelho geometry) / DL 173/2009 and Portaria 296/2010 (membership)
_provenance.method: freguesia-union: CAOP 2025 freguesias dissolved per the freguesia lists in the statutes, resolved through an explicit concordance (data/wine-map/portugal-subregion-membership.json). mapshaper 6% Visvalingam simplify with keep-shapes, interior rings dropped, 5dp, parts under ~0.1 km2 dropped. Where a statute names a freguesia only in part, or names individual quintas, the whole present-day unit is included and the exception is recorded in properties.partial.
_provenance.caveat: DL 173/2009 states that the Douro outlines correspond to the administrative boundaries in force in 1921, so present-day freguesia geometry approximates the legal area even before the 2013 amalgamations.

properties.name: minho
properties.legal: DL 449/99 art. 2: (a) 43 whole concelhos, (c) Arouca, Castelo de Paiva and Vale de Cambra whole, (b) 14 named freguesias of Resende, (d) the freguesia of Ossela in Oliveira de Azemeis.

partial.Resende: the statute names 14 freguesias, i.e. all of Resende except Barro, which is Douro (Baixo Corgo) under DL 173/2009
partial.Oliveira de Azemeis / Ossela: only this one freguesia of the concelho

properties.name: bairrada
properties.legal: Portaria 212/2014 art. 3: Anadia, Mealhada and Oliveira do Bairro whole, plus named freguesias of Agueda, Aveiro, Cantanhede, Coimbra and Vagos.

partial.Agueda / Travasso e Ois da Ribeira: statute names only Ois da Ribeira; CAOP still carries this as one union, so Travasso is included with it
partial.Aveiro / Requeixo, Nossa Senhora de Fati: statute names only Nariz; CAOP still carries this as one union
partial.Coimbra / Antuzede e Vil de Matos: statute names only Vil de Matos; CAOP still carries this as one union
partial._note: Agueda's Agueda/Borralha/Barro/Aguada de Baixo/Belazaima do Chao and Vagos' Covao do Lobo and Santa Catarina were 2013 unions that CAOP 2025 shows de-merged, so those are now included exactly as the statute names them rather than as whole unions.

properties.name: palmela
properties.legal: Portaria 783/2009 art. 2: the municipalities of Montijo, Palmela and Setubal, and the freguesia of Castelo in Sesimbra.

properties.name: minho-ave
properties.legal: Portaria 28/2001 1.º b): nine whole concelhos plus Vizela except the freguesias of Vizela (Santo Adriao) and Barrosas (Santa Eulalia), which belong to Sousa.

properties.name: minho-baiao
properties.legal: Portaria 28/2001 1.º c): Baiao whole, Resende except Barro, Cinfaes except Travanca and Souselo.

partial.Resende / Barro: excluded — it is Douro (Baixo Corgo) under DL 173/2009
partial.Cinfaes / Travanca, Souselo: excluded — they belong to the Paiva sub-region

properties.name: minho-paiva
properties.legal: Portaria 28/2001 1.º h): the concelho of Castelo de Paiva, plus the freguesias of Travanca and Souselo in Cinfaes.

properties.name: minho-sousa
properties.legal: Portaria 28/2001 1.º i): five whole concelhos, plus the freguesias of Vizela (Santo Adriao) and Barrosas (Santa Eulalia) in Vizela.

partial.Vizela / Santa Eulalia: the statute writes this as Barrosas (Santa Eulalia); CAOP 2025 carries it as Santa Eulalia within Vizela
